feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 November 2026 4:40pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 26 November 2026 at 4:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds, with occasional gales overnight.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland will drive a frontal tough across the area tonight


##Wind##

South or southeast mainly 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 this evening, occasionally touching gale 8 overnight. Becoming cyclonic 4 to 6 tomorrow morning, decreasing 3 to 5 by midday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the west this evening, heavy at times. Becoming fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, then settling east or southeast in the evening. Increasing southeast 4 to 6 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight tomorrow afternoon, then building slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
